question: Choosing solar panels
answer: Check wattage, efficiency, warranty (often 25 years performance, 10–12 years product), and brand service network. For resale, buy from authorized distributors with genuine bills for warranty transfers.

question: Inverter sizing
answer: Size inverter to your load and future expansion. Pure sine wave is safer for electronics. Match battery voltage (12/24 V systems). Keep spare fuses and document warranty cards for customers.

question: Solar battery care
answer: Tubular batteries last longer with proper water top-up and ventilation. Do not deep-discharge daily. Offer AMC reminders—it builds trust and repeat business.

question: Selling LED and solar lighting

question: Safe solar installation
answer: Use proper DC fuses, surge protection, and earthing. Train helpers on roof safety. Document site photos for warranty and insurance. Subcontract only to people you trust with credentials.

question: Handling warranty claims
answer: Keep serial numbers and purchase proofs. Register products where required. Respond within 24–48 hours to complaints—fast service drives referrals in local markets.

question: OEM vs branded
answer: Branded products cost more but easier to service. OEM can give margin but needs your quality checks. Start branded for trust, add OEM lines once you know failure modes.
